description:
As a customer, I want to sort the products.

* Sorting should work properly.

cases.title: Products are sorted correctly when a sort option is applied
cases.preconditions: The product list page is reachable and shows several products. The sorting control is available (the story does not specify which sort options exist - not specified in the story).
steps: Note the current order of the displayed products.
Apply one of the available sort options using the sorting control.
Inspect the order of the products shown after sorting.
cases.expected: The products are re-ordered and displayed in the order matching the selected sort option, i.e. sorting works properly. The exact sort options and their resulting order are not specified in the story.

cases.title: Sorting can be changed from one option to another
cases.preconditions: The product list page is reachable and shows several products. At least two sort options are available in the sorting control (the available options are not specified in the story).
steps: Apply the first available sort option and note the resulting order.
Inspect the order of the products shown.
cases.expected: The product list is re-sorted according to the newly selected option; the previously applied sorting no longer determines the order. Sorting works properly for each selected option.

cases.title: Sorting applied to a list with no products or a single product
cases.preconditions: The product list page is reachable and currently shows either no products or exactly one product.
steps: Open the product list page showing no products (or exactly one product).
Apply an available sort option using the sorting control.
cases.expected: Sorting is handled without error; with no products nothing is listed and with one product that product remains listed. The specific behaviour/message for an empty list is not specified in the story.
